anchor: The client synthesizes each request at its trace timestamp with its exact token counts and prefix-sharing structure, and measures TTFT/ITL client-side.
claim_text: The load client synthesizes each request at its exact trace timestamp with exact token counts and prefix-sharing structure, and measures TTFT and ITL client-side.

anchor: Engine timing is identical to the offline runs by construction: live mocker workers load the same AIC latency model, engine arguments, and KV-block capacity --- one TP2 replica per OS process, so replicas die independently.
claim_text: Engine timing matches offline runs: live mocker workers load same AIC latency model, engine arguments, KV-block capacity; one TP2 replica per OS process, replicas die independently.

anchor: The cold-start lead is modeled by delayed spawn (59\,s + a measured 1.0\,s spawn-to-registered latency)
claim_text: Cold-start lead modeled as delayed spawn: 59 seconds plus measured 1.0 second spawn-to-registered latency.

anchor: Each live run is compared against an offline twin --- identical trace, planner configuration, capacity mapping, lead, and budget --- re-run through the replay platform of the preceding chapters.
claim_text: Each live run compared against an offline twin with identical trace, planner configuration, capacity mapping, lead, and budget, re-run through the replay platform.
Forecast policy TTFT p99: live 695 ms, offline 651 ms, delta +6.8%.
Forecast policy ITL p99: live 11.5 ms, offline 9.7 ms, delta +1.8 ms.
Reactive policy ITL p99: live 150.7 ms, offline 152.7 ms, delta -1.3%.

anchor: The anchor holds in both verdict directions: the forecast policy passes the tail SLA live exactly as simulated; the reactive policy fails likewise, its p99 within 1.1\% of the simulation; and provisioned replica-time agrees within 8\%.
claim_text: Anchor holds both verdict directions: forecast passes live as simulated; reactive fails live, its p99 within 1.1% of simulation; provisioned replica-time agrees within 8%.

anchor: The client-observed TTFT tails land within 1.1--6.8\% of the simulated ones (a single live run per policy, so this is a point difference between the two systems, not a repeated-run noise band).
claim_text: Client-observed TTFT tails within 1.1-6.8% of simulated ones (single live run per policy, point difference between systems, not repeated-run noise).

anchor: The anchor covers one window (the hardest), two policies (the contribution and the baseline it beats), the language pool (the pool with a production control path; the encoder pool's controller exists only in simulation), and mocked engine execution.
claim_text: Anchor scope: one window (hardest), two policies (contribution and baseline), language pool (production control path; encoder pool controller only in simulation), mocked engine execution.

anchor: the divergences that do exist (identified, explained, in one case fixed on a local branch to be proposed upstream) are properties of the harnesses, not of the policies this thesis compares.
claim_text: Divergences are properties of harnesses, not policies; identified, explained, one fixed on local branch for upstream proposal.
